author: More Perfect Union
description:
It looks like corporate consolidation is a major reason so many Americans have diarrhea right now.

Just four companies control the majority of America's salad, and one of them is Taylor Farms.

When companies consolidate, they have more power on Capitol Hill — and push for the very deregulation that leads to outbreaks.

Producer: @alcopperman
Editor: @niklaak
Videographer: Jack Belisle
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The corporate conspiracy making you shit your pants

author: More Perfect Union
description: A Flock camera in Sherwood, Arkansas, misread the license plate of an SUV. This led police to detain an innocent couple at gunpoint as their six-week-old baby sat alone in a car seat in the back of the car in February of this year. This is one of dozens of instances nationwide where Flock AI cameras have led to wrongful arrests.
title: A Flock camera misread a license plate — then cops pulled over the wrong car at gunpoint
